Definition: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
BiblicalUsage: 1) not, no, nor, neither, nothing (as wish or preference); 1a) do not, let not (with a verb); 1b) let there not be (with a verb understood); 1c) not, no (with substantive); 1d) nothing (as substantive)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
